2024_206_nov_2023_pcard_report.paragraph: Troy School District's monthly purchasing-card report for November 2023, carried on the Board of Education agenda dated January 16, 2024, itemizes every district PCARD charge posted under the journal-entry description "NOV 2023 PCARD EXP," with transaction dates running from 10/26/2023 through 11/27/2023. Each line lists the merchant abbreviation, the budget unit string, the account code, the transaction amount and any offsetting credit. The schedule closes with a subtotal of 303,782.40 in charges against 9,193.50 in credits, and a stated Total Expenses figure of 294,588.90.

**Format**

Posting dates run from 10/26/2023 through 11/27/2023, so the report captures late-October activity billed into the November cycle.
